verdict.rationale: Twenty has a dedicated developer webhooks page stating it sends an HTTP POST to your URL whenever a record is created, updated, or deleted (twenty-docs-62). Workflows can also be triggered on record changes and include an HTTP request action, which offers a second, customizable way to push events out (twenty-docs-3, twenty-docs-13). Missing for 10: documentation of event filtering or selection, payload schema, signature/security verification, and retry/delivery guarantees, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration that webhooks work reliably.
